rules.text: Sika® ViscoCrete®-140 SK is designed for both High Performance Concrete and Self Compacting Concrete (SCC) with long transportation times and extended workability requirements, very high water reduction and excellent flow characteristics
rules.heading: USES

rules.text: Sika® ViscoCrete®-140 SK does not calcium chloride or any other intentionally added chlorides, and will not initiate or promote the corrosion of the steel reinforcing bars.
rules.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES
